## Description

Asymptotic covariance matrix of the half-vectorization
of the sample covariance matrix in R [@RCoreTeam-2026]
without a distributional assumption
(asymptotic distribution free):
the consistent estimator and its unbiased version.
The functions are internal; other projects can copy them.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `gammaADF` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/gammaADF) with:

```r
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/gammaADF")
```

## Example

The functions are internal:
call them with `gammaADF:::`
or copy them into your project.

```{r}
set.seed(seed = 42)
x <- matrix(data = stats::rnorm(n = 60), nrow = 20)
n <- nrow(x = x)
d <- scale(x = x, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
sigma <- crossprod(x = d) / n
vechsigma <- sigma[lower.tri(x = sigma, diag = TRUE)]
```

The consistent estimate.

```{r}
gamma_consistent <- gammaADF:::.GammaADFConsistent(
  d = d,
  vechsigmacap_consistent = vechsigma,
  n = n
)
dim(x = gamma_consistent)
```

The unbiased estimate needs the normal-theory matrix
(see `gammaN`);
the identity stands in for it here.

```{r}
gamma_unbiased <- gammaADF:::.GammaADFUnbiased(
  gammacapadf_consistent = gamma_consistent,
  gammacapmvn_consistent = diag(x = nrow(x = gamma_consistent)),
  vechsigmacap_consistent = vechsigma,
  n = n
)
dim(x = gamma_unbiased)
```
